Small plane.
Special delivery.

Endless run: deliver each day's parcels before dark. No landings, so mind the fuel.
Climb above the safe-drop marker. Space releases cargo.
After 1 second of free fall, the parachute opens.
Too low = smashed goods. Red ring = unsafe landing.
Gold ring = landing preview, green = on target. Blue depot = refills.
Then fly home through the gold gate and land.
